description.zh: 应用ID。通过控制台创建和查询，仅支持传单个ID。
description.en: The application ID. Create and query the ID in the console. Only a single ID is supported.

description.zh: 任务ID。仅支持传单个ID，和[StartRecordTask](~~193528~~)入参TaskId一致。
description.en: The task ID. Only a single ID is supported. The value must be the same as the TaskId parameter of the [StartRecordTask](~~193528~~) operation.

descriptions.zh:
# 使用说明
调用本接口前，您必须已经调用[StartRecordTask](~~193528~~)开始录制视频任务。
# QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为4000次/分钟。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。更多信息，请参见[QPS限制](~~341645~~)。
descriptions.en:
# Usage notes
Before you call this operation, you must call the [StartRecordTask](~~193528~~) operation to start a video recording task.
# QPS limit
You can call this operation up to 4,000 times per minute per user. If the number of calls per minute exceeds the limit, throttling is triggered, which may affect your business. Call this operation as required. For more information, see [QPS limit](~~341645~~).
